<C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,><C:0001,0004,>- Here Lies a Hero of Buffness -
Muscle Lord Tacklecrush<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Tacklecrush led the charge in the legendary
Assault on New Year's Day Sale Rack.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Many foes stood before him, but with a single
tackle, he scattered them as a tornado.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>None could overtake him as he plunged through
the fray, leaving only wind and failure behind.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Rock hard were his shopping muscles, but none
were equal to the hard lock on his wallet.<C:0003,0001,>
